logic.readme: Run FH loop serving 5-option router items until any family hits count=3. Lock that family. Ask 3 face triad items; compute counts and apply duel rules. Then run Lines: 14 items (2 per line). Produce code_7 + notes + truth_line. See duel_rules for exact sequences.

README.title: Quiz Bank + Runtime Logic — v5 (Family Hone & Duels)
README.purpose: Single artifact to run the v5 quiz: Family Hone (first-to-3), Face Triad + Duels, Lines (14 items), with output contract and audit fields.
README.flow: FH (first-to-3) → Face Triad (3 items) → Face Duels (conditional) → Lines (14 items) → Results (Face, CODE_7, notes, truth line).
quickstart: 1) Serve FH router items (5 options; each maps to a distinct family).
2) Track counts per family; stop when any family reaches 3 picks; lock that family.
3) Ask 3 Face Triad items inside the locked family; tally a 3-count pattern.
4) If pattern is 3-0-0 → done; else apply duel rules (2-option forced choice) per logic.duel_rules.
4) On Lines: skip the locked family line (assume C). For the other six, if the two answers disagree, ask a line duel (token-pair variant).
5) Run Lines: 14 items (2 per line); map to tokens via token_map_default; per-line verdict is max severity.

inputs: user choices on FH router items
user choices on Face Triad items
user choices on Face Duel items (if any)

stage_FH.item_contract: 5 options, each tied to a different family (Control, Pace, Boundary, Truth, Recognition, Bonding, Stress).
scheduler_rules: fill remaining slots from under-exposed and confusables
no family duplicates within one item

duel_rules.2-1-0: duel A vs B; if A loses → duel B vs C; winner = face
duel_rules.2-0-1: duel A vs C; if A loses → duel C vs B; winner = face
duel_rules.1-1-1: duel A vs B → W; duel W vs C → winner = face

constraints: use micro-duel only on hard ties/abstains

stage_Lines.notes: Skip the line matching the locked family; assume token C there. For the other 6 lines, if the two answers disagree (e.g., C vs O), trigger a line duel using the matching token-pair variant.

telemetry: family distribution (by population and over time)
completion drop-off by stage; avg duration
authoring_rules: FH: 5 distinct families; no duplicate family per item.
Triad: 3 distinct faces; pick sharpest discriminators for that family.
Duel: 2 options; forced-choice; one clear differentiator; no 'depends'.
Lines: balanced wording; keep tokens aligned with map.
